allah@1: You were given the Name before you had a word for the trouble. What would you say to Him tonight if you did not have to explain it first?
ar-raheem@1: What did you ask for once, out loud, and then stop tracking? It did not stop being answered when you stopped watching.
al-malik@1: Name the person whose decision you are waiting on. Whose hand is theirs inside?
al-quddus@1: Some of tonight's weight is the thing itself. Some of it is what you think it has done to Him. Which half have you never actually separated out?
al-mumin@1: You have been trying to be brave enough. What changes if being made safe was never something you rise to?
al-azeez@1: You are waiting to be believed. What would you keep doing if what was coming were reinforcement rather than agreement?
al-khaliq@1: Where in your life have you been living as though you were an accident that kept going?
al-wahhab@1: You know exactly what you asked for. What turned up that you never thought to ask for at all?
al-aleem@1: What have you been explaining to Him that He already knew before you finished the sentence?
al-hayy@1: Name the person whose loss you cannot picture surviving. Now say the one Name in that sentence that will still be true afterwards.
al-qayyum@1: Name the stretch when you stopped. What do you imagine was let go of while you were not looking?
an-nur@1: You have been asking for light to be handed to you. What was asked for at the end of that prayer was something else. What would that take?
al-fattah@1: Name the door. Now name the person you have been treating as the one who decides.
al-qabid@1: What was taken from you that seemed to go nowhere? Where do you actually think it went?
al-basit@1: How sure are you tonight that nothing is coming? Notice that the certainty is the part the oath is spent on.
al-haleem@1: Every hour you have ever had was inside that distance. What have you been using yours to do?
al-kareem@1: What request have you retired, on the grounds that you had already made it too many times?
at-tawwab@1: You think you have to arrive before you can be met. How far along did you decide you needed to get?
al-hadi@1: You have been reading not knowing the way as falling behind. What if it were the reason the prayer exists at all?
as-samad@1: Name one person you are sure is managing on their own. Now reconsider.
al-wakeel@1: Which outcome are you holding tonight that was never actually assigned to you?
al-lateef@1: What have you not been able to put into words? What happens if the words were never the requirement?
al-mujeeb@1: You have counted how many times you said it. Has anything ever come back that you did not count?
ash-shafi@1: What are you asking to have put back exactly as it was? What if that were the smaller request?
ar-raqeeb@1: Name something you did in an empty room this week. Somebody went up with it.
ar-rafi@1: Someone described you correctly this week. What is the truer sentence about you that they did not have?
as-sami@1: You said it and heard nothing back. What if that silence were the pause between two speakers rather than the end of it?
al-ghafur@1: What are you most afraid of being found out for? It was heard once, in private, and never told to anyone.
al-wasi@1: What have you decided there is no room for? Check whether it is the room that ran out, or you.
al-haqq@1: Name what has power over you tonight. Then ask who made it, and whether they knew what they had made.
al-waliyy@1: Name the people you are far from tonight. Who do you think is with them?
al-muid@1: She said the words before she could mean them, and the narration keeps both. What would you say tonight, ahead of feeling it?
al-qadir@1: What do you believe and still not feel? Asking to be shown was never held against anyone.
al-afuw@1: You have been asking to be excused. What would you ask for instead, if you could ask for it to be gone?
ar-rauf@1: What are you still trying to become strong enough for? The number was never lowered because someone finally was.
al-mughni@1: You did the arithmetic and came out short. What did you leave out of the sum?
al-baqi@1: Name what you gave away this year. That is the part you still have.
